support.time_alignment: Every saved post-state is used, including the last. MuJoCo q alone backs up physics_dt*qvel to match saved implicitfast body poses and contacts; PhysX uses direct post q.
support.window_scope: post2/post8/post20 include samples at or after the stated second. Missing windows are null; a single endpoint sample is not a sustained hold.
support.geometry_scope: Foot sphere bottom world Z is reported relative to saved ground; thigh differences use same-side world link origins. XY motion is sphere-center displacement, not contact-point slip or a footstep label.
support.contact_scope: 50Hz net-force magnitudes, not vertical loading or contact pairs. world and empty names are excluded from robot nonfoot force statistics; saved nonfoot ground-pair counts are separate.
support.threshold_scope: Existing 3cm clearance, net foot force 1N, robot nonfoot force 5N and zero thigh-height difference are descriptions, not new acceptance thresholds. FK tolerance 1e-4 validates saved-state alignment only.
support.evidence_limit: CPU saved-state FK on a provisional model; no new simulation, hardware validity, world-fixed EE-only success or proof of gait/support success.
